# Seats Reserved for Women

<!-- STEP id="one-third" -->
## Not Less Than One-Third

**Article 243(d)** provides not less than one-third reservation for women in the seats filled by direct election in every Panchayat.

Try it: with 20 seats, find the lowest number that is allowed.

<!-- STEP id="states-go-further" -->
## Many States Go to 50%

**21 States and 2 Union Territories** have gone further, to 50% in Panchayati Raj Institutions.

**Article 243(t)** gives the same one-third in every Municipality, and **17 States and 1 Union Territory** have given 50% (2023).
